sources.title: Introducing the next generation of Claude
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The March 4, 2024 announcement names Claude 3 Sonnet, gives its 200K context window and vision capabilities, and says it is available that day in the Anthropic API and Claude.ai. Its model-details and comparison sections provide no nominal total or active parameter count and no named, sized base-model relationship. This is also the official-documentation link offered by the secondary 100B claim in s14.

sources.title: Scaling Monosemanticity: Extracting Interpretable Features from Claude 3 Sonnet
sources.evidence: Rechecked October 27, 2026 using the complete fresh primary-text cache and live indexed primary source. The May 21, 2024 paper explicitly identifies the production finetuned Sonnet 3.0 released March 4, 2024, and says it intentionally does not report model size because the model is proprietary. The 1M, 4M and 34M sizes describe SAE features, not Claude parameters. The paper establishes a pretrained/finetuned relationship but supplies no sized base from which a nominal count could be inherited. Its residual-stream, MLP and transformer descriptions do not define a separate active count.

sources.title: Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The October 29, 2025 study explicitly includes production Sonnet 3 and helpful-only variants sharing each production model's pretrained base. This establishes post-training lineage without publishing a nominal size for Sonnet 3 or its base; no total or active count appears in the article. Layer-index sweeps and internal activations are experiment settings, not parameter counts.

sources.title: Claude can now use tools
sources.evidence: May 30, 2024 announcement makes tool use generally available across the entire Claude 3 family on the Anthropic Messages API, Bedrock and Vertex AI. This establishes historical function calling for Sonnet 3.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code
sources.evidence: February 24, 2025 announcement introduces the first hybrid reasoning model and its optional extended-thinking mode and thinking budget. This is the later introduction of the dedicated thinking capability, distinct from ordinary reasoning in Claude 3.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: The January 21, 2025 history section explicitly identifies claude-3-sonnet-20240229 as Claude Sonnet 3 and records retirement on July 21, 2025.

sources.title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet model card addendum (June 2024)
sources.evidence: The eight-page later card has exact Claude 3 Sonnet comparison columns, including Tables 1-5. These report evaluation results and context-length retrieval, not parameter counts; no parameter-count disclosure was found in its text.

sources.title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (new) and Claude 3.5 Haiku model card addendum (October 2024)
sources.evidence: The fourteen-page later card includes exact Claude 3 Sonnet columns in Tables 4-7. They contain coding, vision, refusal and reasoning evaluations, with no total or active parameter-count disclosure found.

sources.title: The Claude 3 Model Family: Opus, Sonnet, Haiku
sources.evidence: The indexed first-page introduction explicitly describes the family, including Sonnet, as accepting images with text prompts and producing text. Access was limited to the indexed primary-source extract: the full PDF exceeded the browsing size limit and direct download returned HTTP 403. No complete-card parameter search is claimed.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: September 2026 first-party research states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This general distribution-policy evidence corroborates the exact Sonnet 3 proprietary classification in s2; no newer-model technical specifications are transferred.

sources.title: Claude 3 family model card with later addenda — complete accessible copy
sources.evidence: Independently searched the complete 64-page card and both 2024 addenda from the primary PDF retrieved October 27, 2026. Page 20 describes parameter counts increasing from Haiku to Opus without giving numbers. The June addendum Tables 1-5 and October addendum Tables 4-7 include Claude 3 Sonnet comparisons but report benchmark, refusal and retrieval results, with no total or activated-parameter columns. The original introduction and training description provide no named, sized base-model lineage. No nominal total or active count was found in the full text.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet System Card
sources.evidence: Checked the complete primary PDF text retrieved October 27, 2026. Page 12 Tables 1 and 2 explicitly compare Claude 3 Sonnet with later models, but their columns report BBQ bias and accuracy percentages; neither supplies a total or activated-parameter count. The full card contains no numeric size or sized lineage disclosure for Claude 3 Sonnet.

sources.title: The engineering challenges of scaling interpretability
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026 to resolve parameter-related search leads. The June 13, 2024 follow-up describes scaling interpretability to Claude 3 Sonnet. Its millions of features, 100 billion data points, 100TB dataset and sharding quantities concern SAE research infrastructure rather than the production model parameter count. It publishes no nominal total or active count.

sources.title: Claude 3 Sonnet - Anthropic | LLM Bento
sources.evidence: Checked October 27, 2026 solely as a secondary search lead. The page lists approximately 100 billion parameters without an attributable size source. Its Official Documentation link resolves to the Anthropic launch article s1, which does not state that count. The estimate is rejected as an unsupported specification; it does not override the exact-model primary disclosure policy.

name.note: The current deprecation history uses this ordering for the exact API ID; the launch name was Claude 3 Sonnet.

developer.note: Anthropic's own launch announcement identifies this model as its release.

family.note: Sonnet is explicitly a member of the Claude 3 family; claude is the catalog family key.

release_date.note: The public launch and immediate API availability occurred March 4. The 20240229 identifier suffix is not the public launch date.

open_weights.note: Exact-model proprietary classification is corroborated by Anthropic's explicit statement that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users.

license.note: Supported descriptive classification, not an asserted open-source license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh primary-source review confirms that Anthropic explicitly withheld Claude 3 Sonnet size. The complete card, 2024 addenda, later 3.7 comparison tables and introspection follow-up disclose no nominal total or sized base-model lineage. SAE sizes are feature counts. A secondary approximate 100B listing was traced to a launch article that does not support it.

active_parameters_b.note: Independently rechecked the complete card and later exact-model comparison tables: none publishes an activated-parameter column or separately defined active count for Sonnet 3. Neither model architecture nor SAE activation statistics establish such a count; total-equals-active is not inferred.

architecture.note: Generic Transformer structure is supported by exact-model interpretability research. Dense versus MoE, layer count and model width remain undisclosed.

context_window.note: The Sonnet-specific launch section states a 200K-token context window.

modalities.note: Text/image inputs and text output are explicit in the complete model card. PDF is an eligible catalog input format, but no retained exact Sonnet 3 provider specification establishing PDF support was found.

reasoning.note: Interpreted as a dedicated extended-thinking capability. Anthropic introduced that hybrid mode with Sonnet 3.7; Sonnet 3's ordinary reasoning and prompted chain-of-thought evaluations do not imply it. This is a historical inference from the developer feature introduction, not an assertion about ordinary reasoning ability.

tool_call.note: Historical tool/function calling was generally available May 30, 2024. This does not claim the retired endpoint operates today.

description.value: Historical Anthropic Claude model with text and image inputs, text output, a 200,000-token context window, and tool calling.
description.note: Replaces the generic historical-release wording with supported capabilities; avoids performance superlatives.

patch.description: Historical Anthropic Claude model with text and image inputs, text output, a 200,000-token context window, and tool calling.
patch.notes: Anthropic explicitly withholds Claude 3 Sonnet's size; total and active parameters remain undisclosed, with no published sized-base lineage. Its exact-model interpretability research confirms Transformer structure without identifying dense versus MoE. Public launch was March 4, 2024; the API snapshot suffix is 20240229. Tool use became generally available May 30, 2024. The reasoning flag denotes dedicated extended thinking, not ordinary reasoning ability. Anthropic records this API model as retired July 21, 2025.

sources.label: Complete Claude 3 model card with later addenda
Later exact-model introspection and base-lineage research

summary: October 27 parameter-only re-audit retains explicit null total and active counts. Fresh review covers the exact production-model size-withholding statement, complete Claude 3 card and 2024 addenda, Claude 3.7 comparison tables, and later introspection/engineering research. None supplies a nominal count or a sized base-model lineage; SAE feature counts are not model counts. The secondary approximate 100B lead links to a launch article that does not substantiate it. Other field assessments are preserved.
